correctness.rationale: For sufficiently small endpoint radii, inverse images remain in the exact affine endpoint branches; stationarity then yields U(r)=pU(r/a)+qU(r/b) and V(r)=pV(r/b)+qV(r/a). Positive drift makes each convex characteristic function dip below one then cross exactly once at positive kappa. For s<kappa choose barrier C r^s with Phi(s)<1, for s>kappa barrier c r^s with Phi(s)>1; compact max/min principle on [0,R] controls endpoints and gives c r^t<=U(r)<=C r^s for s<kappa<t. Log divide (with negative log r) gives local dimension. Tonelli identity int x^-t dmu =1+t int_0^1 r^-t-1 U(r)dr yields finite for t<kappa, infinite for t>kappa. Difference Phi0-Phi1=(p-q)(a^-s-b^-s) proves root ordering. Critical t=kappa not claimed. Independent bisection for (a,b,p)=(1/3,8,.55) gives roots .28171392907808834 and .5524212948436695; only corroborative.
